# Complaint log reading notes

We read the first entries of the quarterly complaint log to see whether they point to one cause. The first three entries are shown below.

| ID | Date | Route | Complaint |
|---|---|---|---|
| C-101 | 2025-04-03 | Route 7 | At 8 a.m. the bus was so full I could not board; three buses in a row were full. |
| C-102 | 2025-04-15 | Route 12 | The gap between two buses in the evening was over 15 minutes. |
| C-103 | 2025-04-22 | Route 7 | The driver did not stop at the university stop because the bus was full. |

Two of the three entries mention full buses and the third a long gap between buses, so timetable changes look like the first thing to examine.
